map.日用电 30 kWh，其中 20 kWh 移至谷段（0.3 元）替代峰段（0.9: Daily usage 30 kWh, of which 20 kWh is shifted to the valley segment (0.3 CNY) instead of the peak segment (0.9 CNY): original 30×0.58=17.4 CNY, after optimization 10×0.9+20×0.3=15 CNY, saving 2.4 CNY/day, about 876 CNY/year. map.阶梯电价怎么算？: How is the tiered tariff calculated?
map.按累计用量分段计价，增量部分适用更高单价，因此高用量月费用非线性上升。: Priced in segments by cumulative usage, with the incremental portion at a higher unit price, so the cost in high-usage months rises non-linearly.
map.峰谷电价适合谁？: Who is peak-valley pricing suitable for?
map.可转移负荷（储能、热水、充电桩）用户受益大；刚性实时负荷受益有限。: Users with shiftable loads (storage, water heating, EV chargers) benefit greatly; rigid real-time loads benefit little.
